headline: IREDA shares fall over sixty percent from peak amid top management concerns
hook: Renewable finance stock loses over sixty percent
summary: Shares of the Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency have declined over sixty percent from their all-time high of ₹310 reached in July 2024 to trade around ₹111. The correction follows a government decision regarding top management at the state-owned lender. Retail investors holding PSU green energy stocks face prolonged valuation contraction amid leadership uncertainty. Monitoring management changes and policy support for renewable financing remains critical for shareholders.
whats_next: Official government announcement on top management appointments
why_it_matters: PSU green energy holdings face valuation pressure.
